name: vtk-minimal
description: VTK built with ONLY the modules duck_vtk needs to read mesh files.
This exists because vcpkg's official `vtk` port is unusable for a database
extension: it carries 26 transitive dependencies (glew, freetype, gl2ps, qt,
hdf5, netcdf, proj, ...) because rendering is part of its BASE port rather
than an optional feature. Building that in CI takes hours per platform and
produces a binary bloated with an OpenGL stack that a SQL engine will never
This port disables rendering, Qt, Python, MPI, imaging, views and testing
using upstream VTK's own documented CMake options. No source is patched, so
there is nothing to re-base when VTK is upgraded — only a version and hash.
The resulting closure is 3 dependencies instead of 26.
